tagline: The map, the architecture and the honest status of the suite, with the tools that keep it consistent.
description: EH3D-DOCS holds Markdown documents: the map of the suite, its architecture notes, the capability matrix that separates what has been tested on a computer from what has run on a machine, and the conventions of the repositories. Python tools keep the suite consistent: the repository check that every repository carries, the contract between the repositories, the scripts that raise a version and prepare a release, and the scripts that set up a workspace and make a new repository. It runs nothing on a machine.
